scope: Actual shared Manufacturing/Queue functions under bounded synthetic DOM/command-reply fixtures across four modes; no Android/native gameplay. Layout pixels are covered separately by the host-browser fixture.
checks: towers: compact Manufacturing rail has no FACTORIES/Units strip and keeps Design/Blueprints controls
towers: unit rows use MANUFACTURE/repeat without quantities or bottom activity; matching hardware alone gets live progress
towers: idle repeat only arms the selected factory/recipe until one MANUFACTURE command is sent
towers: finite and saved-design manufacture each send one real request with an explicit repeat Boolean
towers: matching live repeat ON/OFF sends one set-repeat; rejection rolls back and busy taps cannot race
towers: one STOP command replaces OPEN/CANCEL controls and clears only its factory draft after acknowledgement
towers: rejected STOP preserves drafts and pending manufacture/repeat prevents a racing STOP
towers: a late repeat acknowledgement cannot redraw another selected factory or another page
towers: save rewind/player change clears draft/in-flight identities and ignores old manufacture/repeat/STOP replies
towers: destroyed factory drafts are pruned while another live factory remains unchanged
